stages.name: White Cross
stages.description: Form a white cross on the white face with correct edge colors matching the center pieces.
stages.goal: The white face shows a + shape, and each edge piece matches the center color of the adjacent face.

stages.name: White Corners
stages.description: Insert the four white corner pieces to complete the first layer.
stages.goal: The entire white face is complete, and the first layer side colors match their center pieces.

algorithms.description: Insert a white corner from the bottom-right position into the top layer.
Insert a white corner from the bottom-left position into the top layer.

stages.name: Middle Layer Edges
stages.description: Insert the four middle layer edge pieces without disturbing the completed first layer.
stages.goal: The first two layers (F2L) are complete — white face done and middle ring of colors matches centers.

algorithms.notation: U R U' R' U' F' U F
algorithms.description: Insert an edge piece from the top layer into the middle layer on the right side.

algorithms.notation: U' L' U L U F U' F'
algorithms.description: Insert an edge piece from the top layer into the middle layer on the left side.

stages.name: Yellow Cross
stages.description: Form a yellow cross on the yellow face (top).
stages.goal: The yellow face shows a + shape. Corner orientation does not matter yet.

algorithms.notation: F R U R' U' F'
algorithms.description: Orients the yellow edges. Apply 1-3 times depending on the starting pattern.

cases.name: Dot
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F' (×2-3)
cases.description: No edges oriented — apply algorithm twice.

cases.name: L-Shape
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'
cases.description: Two adjacent edges oriented — hold L in top-left and apply once.

cases.name: Line
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'
cases.description: Two opposite edges oriented — hold line horizontal and apply once.

stages.name: Yellow Face
stages.description: Orient all yellow stickers on the yellow face so the entire face is solid yellow.
stages.goal: The entire yellow face is yellow. Side colors of the last layer may still be incorrect.

algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.description: Orients corners. Apply 1-2 times with correct positioning.

cases.name: Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'
cases.description: One corner oriented — hold the oriented corner at front-left.

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'
cases.description: Mirror case — one corner oriented, different angle.

stages.name: Position Yellow Corners
stages.description: Move the yellow corner pieces to their correct positions (permutation).
stages.goal: Each yellow corner is in its correct position, though they may need to be twisted.

algorithms.notation: U R U' L' U R' U' L
algorithms.description: Cycles three corners clockwise. Apply 1-2 times to position all corners.

stages.name: Permute Yellow Edges
stages.description: Cycle the yellow edge pieces to their final correct positions to complete the cube.

algorithms.notation: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2
algorithms.description: Cycles three edges clockwise. Apply 1-2 times to solve.

cases.name: Clockwise
cases.moves: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

cases.name: Counter-clockwise
cases.moves: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'

stages.name: Efficient Cross
stages.description: Build the cross in 8 moves or fewer, with proper planning and color neutrality.
stages.goal: Solve the cross in ≤8 moves with all edges correctly oriented to their centers.

stages.name: F2L (First Two Layers)
stages.description: Pair corner-edge pieces and insert them simultaneously. 41 algorithms total, but intuitive F2L is recommended first.
stages.goal: All 4 F2L slots filled — first two layers complete in far fewer moves than beginner method.

algorithms.description: Basic case: edge and corner already paired, insert with R trigger.
Basic case: edge and corner already paired, insert with L trigger.

algorithms.notation: U R U' R' U' F U F'
algorithms.description: Split a misaligned pair and insert using R and F triggers.

algorithms.notation: U' R U R' U R U' R'
algorithms.description: 3-cycle approach for pairing separated corner and edge.

stages.name: OLL (2-Look)
stages.description: Orient the last layer in two steps: edges first, then corners. Uses 9 algorithms instead of 57.
stages.goal: Entire yellow face is solid yellow.

algorithms.notation: F R U R' U' F'
algorithms.description: Edge orientation: same as beginner yellow cross.

cases.name: Dot
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'

cases.name: L-Shape
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'

cases.name: Line
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'

algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'

cases.name: Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'

cases.name: Double Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R' (×2)

cases.name: Headlights
cases.moves: R2 D R' U2 R D' R' U2 R'

stages.name: OLL (Full)
stages.description: Learn all 57 OLL cases for one-look last layer orientation.
stages.goal: One algorithm to orient the entire last layer — no second step needed.

algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.description: Sune — the most common OLL case.

cases.name: Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'

cases.name: All Corners
cases.moves: R U2 R2 F R F' U2 R' F R F'

cases.name: Knight Move
cases.moves: r U R' U R U2 r'

stages.name: PLL (2-Look)
stages.description: Permute the last layer in two steps: corners first, then edges. Uses 6 algorithms instead of 21.

algorithms.notation: U R U' L' U R' U' L

cases.name: A-Perm (adj)
cases.moves: U R U' L' U R' U' L

cases.name: E-Perm
cases.moves: x' R U' R' D R U R' D' R U R' D R U' R' D'

algorithms.notation: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

cases.name: U-Perm
cases.moves: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

cases.name: Ua-Perm
cases.moves: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'

cases.name: H-Perm
cases.moves: M2 U M2 U2 M2 U M2
cases.description: All four edges need swapping (opposite edges swap).

cases.name: Z-Perm
cases.moves: M2 U M2 U M' U2 M2 U2 M' U2

stages.name: PLL (Full)
stages.description: Learn all 21 PLL cases for one-look last layer permutation.
stages.goal: One algorithm to permute the entire last layer — maximum solve speed.

algorithms.notation: R2 U R' U R' U' R U' R2 D U' R' U R D'
algorithms.description: G-perm — one of the PLL cases with specific piece movements.

cases.name: T-Perm
cases.moves: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
cases.description: Swap two adjacent corners and edges.

cases.name: Y-Perm
cases.moves: F R U' R' U' R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R F'
cases.description: Swap diagonal corners and adjacent edges.

cases.name: J-Perm
cases.moves: R' U L' U2 R U' R' U2 R L
cases.description: Swap two adjacent corners and the opposite edge.

cases.name: F-Perm
cases.moves: R' U' F' R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R'
cases.description: Swap two adjacent corners with complex edge movement.
